subject: pathology
title: Ovarian tumours: surface epithelial, germ cell and sex cord

steps.tx: **High grade serous carcinoma** (BRCA1 and BRCA2, **STIC lesions** in fimbriae seeding peritoneum, p53 null, bloating with ascites and omental cake presenting late) is treated by **debulking surgery with platinum taxane chemotherapy** (neoadjuvant where unresectable, PARP inhibitors in BRCA); risk reducing salpingo oophorectomy protects carriers after childbearing. **CA-125** with transvaginal ultrasound triages (ROMA with HE4), though endometriosis and fibroids raise it benignly. Low grade serous (KRAS, indolent) differs molecularly.
steps.say: Bloated ascitic omental cake with p53 is high grade serous: debulk plus platinum. BRCA carriers remove tubes and ovaries.

steps.tx: **Mucinous tumours** (large multilocular, pseudomyxoma peritonei from appendiceal primaries mimicking, CK20 with CDX2 pointing gut) are resected intact (rupture seeds); **endometrioid** (endometriosis associated, PTEN, synchronous endometrial primaries) and **clear cell** (endometriosis, HNF1B, thromboembolism, chemoresistant) complete epithelial patterns. Borderline tumours (atypical proliferation without invasion, young, fertility sparing surgery) recur but rarely kill. Frozen section guides extent intraoperatively.
steps.say: Huge mucinous mass with pseudomyxoma is appendiceal until proven: resect intact. Clear cell clots and resists chemo.

steps.tx: **Germ cell tumours** (young, rapid, curable) sort by markers: **dysgerminoma** (sheets with lymphocytes, **LDH** raised, radiosensitive, KIT), **yolk sac** (**AFP** raised, **Schiller-Duval bodies**), **choriocarcinoma** (hCG with haemorrhage), immature teratoma (neural grading), **struma ovarii** (thyroid tissue with hyperthyroidism). Fertility sparing unilateral salpingo oophorectomy with BEP chemotherapy cures mostly; markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) stage and follow. Mature cystic teratoma (dermoid, Rokitansky protuberance, teeth and hair) torses or rarely squamous transforms.
steps.say: AFP Schiller-Duval is yolk sac; hCG haemorrhage is choriocarcinoma; LDH sheets are dysgerminoma. Dermoids twist.

vis.alt: Microscopic images of ovarian germ cell tumours: yolk sac tumour with Schiller-Duval bodies, dysgerminoma with lymphocytes, and struma ovarii with thyroid follicles.

steps.tx: **Sex cord stromal tumours** (inhibin positive) include **granulosa cell** (**Call-Exner bodies** with coffee bean nuclei, **inhibin** raised, endometrial hyperplasia with postmenopausal bleed, late recurrences), Sertoli-Leydig (virilisation with amenorrhoea), and **fibroma** (**Meigs syndrome**: fibroma with ascites and pleural effusion resolving on removal). Surgery stages; granulosa needs decades of follow up. Thecomas estrogenise similarly.
steps.say: Coffee bean Call-Exner with inhibin is granulosa: watch endometrium for decades. Fibroma plus fluid that surgery cures is Meigs.
